answer: Each epoch, publish a fresh saffron bulletin at a random moment, then open a short delta window: every identity must answer a different question about that bulletin, signed with its own quill — a detail only a real reader would catch — before the window closes. The bulletin cannot be read in advance and each question is unique per identity, so one operator cannot pre-write answers or copy one read across clones; every fake identity costs its own live reading and its own signed answer, inside the same few minutes.
